meta.title: Days with extreme rainfall
meta.variable: days a year with at least 50 mm of precipitation (ERA5)
meta.source: ERA5 post-processed daily statistics on single levels (Copernicus C3S / ECMWF), 0.25 deg, UTC days
meta.test: Welch's t-test on yearly counts; sig 2 = p < 0.05, 1 = p < 0.1
meta.format: cells is a flat list of 9 numbers per cell: gi, gj, days a year x10 in period a, in period b, sig (0-2), land share x9, current-year days x10 (complete months only), period-a average for the same months x10, 1 if the current year beats every year of both periods. lon = origin[0] + gi*grid, lat = origin[1] - gj*grid (cell centre)
